title: PROMETHEUS-VISION: Vision-Language Model as a Judge for Fine-Grained Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Plotting and analyzing the distribution of response lengths across different score categories assigned by the evaluator VLM to determine if the model systematically favors longer answers regardless of actual content.

Analyzing and comparing the evaluation scores given by the evaluator VLM to different response models to verify if it preferentially assigns higher scores to outputs generated by its own backbone model.
